title: Cross-test's era-1 'documented split' pin is vacuous — no assertion anywhere pins the era-1 legacy predicate
detail: The claimed era-1 pin cannot fail: if era_pipe_is_legacy at era 1 flipped false (gate stops requiring narrow modernization before the 1→2 advance), the cross-test loop skips (era<2), decay-math still passes, and no golden catches it.
recommended_fix: Assert the split: `if era == 1 { testing.expectf(t, legacy != decayed || !legacy, ...) }` or add direct pins `expect(era_pipe_is_legacy(cat,1,na))` plus `expect_value(pipe_effective_capacity(cat,1,na),10)` side by side in test_legacy_predicate_and_decay_math.
